1. Description

This pairing examines average surface air temperatures over land in the contiguous United States (CONUS), focusing on average temperatures for each meteorological season. It builds upon Figures 1 and 2 in EPA’s Seasonal Temperature indicator and includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1896.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.
